requirements.description: Compustat Fundamentals Annual accounting fields for the extended-accrual inputs, sample availability rules and next-year ROA outcome: item 1 CHE; item 4 ACT; item 5 LCT; item 6 AT; item 9 DLTT; item 32 IVAO (Investments and Advances—Other); item 34 DLC; item 130 PSTK; item 178 OIADP; item 181 LT; and item 193 IVST. Include GVKEY/DATADATE/FYEAR and annual-record descriptors needed to select annual observations. Missing items 9, 32, 34, 130 and 193 are set to zero; items 1, 4, 5, 6 and 181 are required in t and t−1 and item 178 in t.

required_coverage.population: Annual firm-years in the authors’ Compustat–CRSP sample for regression year t=1962–2001, excluding SIC 6000–6999 and requiring the stated financial-statement items; the fitted-row N is not reported.
required_coverage.detail: Regression year t spans 1962–2001. Changes in all accrual components require year t−1 (1961–2000), and ROA_{t+1} requires item 178 in 1963–2002; union of known raw Compustat years is 1961–2002. The year t sample screen also requires items 1,4,5,6,12,181 in current and previous year plus item 178 in current year; item 12 is kept in a separate unresolved requirement. The paper does not state exact Funda format/consolidation/population-source selectors or datadate-to-regression-year assignment.

routes.mapping_notes: The article gives the semantic Compustat item names and formulas for these components (including the distinction between item 1 “Cash and Short Term Investments” and item 193 “Short Term Investments”). Current Funda catalog labels and the exact probe identify the corresponding named fields CHE, ACT, LCT, AT, LT, OIADP, DLTT, IVAO, DLC, PSTK and IVST. This is a semantic label match to the paper’s stated definitions, not an item-number/name guess. The item-12 sample-only field is separate; Compustat row-selection conventions remain unspecified.
routes.coverage_notes: Fields/access are verified against the exact current Compustat annual file. No coordinator confirmation establishes 1961–2002 historical coverage for this sample population, and the paper does not specify current annual-record format/consolidation/population filters.

variable_coverage.construction: ROA_{t+1}=OIADP_{t+1}/average AT_{t+1}; use Compustat item 178, and estimate in the authors’ retained sample. The sample requires items 1,4,5,6,12,181 in t and t−1 and item178 in t; excludes SIC 6000–6999; requires Compustat–CRSP daily-return data. Item12 field mapping and sample/link date rules remain unresolved.
ROA_t=OIADP_t/average AT_t, using Compustat item 178 and average total assets; denominator endpoints are not defined.
DCOA_t=[(ACT_t−CHE_t)−(ACT_{t−1}−CHE_{t−1})]/average AT_t; maps item4 current assets and item1 cash/short-term investments; item1 is not item193.
−DCOL_t=−{[(LCT_t−DLC_t)−(LCT_{t−1}−DLC_{t−1})]/average AT_t}; preserve the Table 5 negative-liability term.
DNCOA_t=[(AT_t−ACT_t−IVAO_t)−(AT_{t−1}−ACT_{t−1}−IVAO_{t−1})]/average AT_t; item32 is Investments and Advances—Other.
−DNCOL_t=−{[(LT_t−LCT_t−DLTT_t)−(LT_{t−1}−LCT_{t−1}−DLTT_{t−1})]/average AT_t}; preserve the Table 5 negative-liability term.
DSTI_t=(IVST_t−IVST_{t−1})/average AT_t; use item193 Short-Term Investments, distinct from item1 CHE.
DLTI_t=(IVAO_t−IVAO_{t−1})/average AT_t; item32 Investments and Advances—Other.
−DFINL_t=−{[(DLTT_t+DLC_t+PSTK_t)−(DLTT_{t−1}+DLC_{t−1}+PSTK_{t−1})]/average AT_t}; preserve the negative term and item9/34/130 zero-fill rule.

design_coverage.reason: The selected fit is annual cross-sectional OLS; the paper describes 40 separate annual regressions and reports no fixed-effect dummies. Annual grouping is part of the estimator, not evidence of year fixed effects.
No clustered standard errors are reported for this baseline; the paper reports Fama–MacBeth t-statistics across the annual coefficient series.
Table 5 Panel C equation and notes do not name a weight variable or weighting procedure.

implementation_issues.description: The paper specifies that ROA and accrual components are deflated by average total assets but does not define the average-assets endpoints or exact fiscal-year/date convention. For annual ROA_{t+1}, this affects which AT observations are paired with OIADP_{t+1}; for t accrual measures it affects scaling alongside the t−1 changes.

The sample footnote requires Compustat item 12 in current and previous years but does not state its semantic item name. The current Funda SALE field is only an unverified candidate; it is not mapped by item-number/name resemblance. The sample cannot be exactly filtered until this mapping is resolved.

The article identifies the SIC exclusion range but not the source field (Compustat SICH vs CRSP HSICCD) or whether SIC is evaluated at the financial year-end, another date, or a different annual classification. This can change which firms are included.

The Compustat–CRSP matched sample needs effective-dated GVKEY/PERMNO links, but the paper does not report the link product, linktype/linkprim/used-flag filters, multiple-security treatment, or exact match date.

The table specifies numeric winsorization bounds +1 and −1 but does not specify which annual regression variables are treated as “each component of earnings,” whether winsorization is cross-sectional by year or pooled, or its order relative to deflation.
The authors report Fama–MacBeth means and t-statistics from 40 annual cross-sections but do not state any serial-correlation adjustment or exact finite-sample t-statistic formula.

The displayed final multivariate row reports t-statistics under the seven accrual terms but not under the intercept or ROA_t; the regression-specific annual Ns are not reported. Preserve these omissions rather than infer model statistics from descriptive counts.

The assessment routes to current local Compustat and CRSP tables while retaining the paper’s 1962–2001 design; the authors’ contemporaneous data vintage and any historical vendor revisions are not identified.

The paper’s item wording distinguishes item 1 “Cash and Short Term Investments” from item 193 “Short Term Investments”; use CHE only for the former and IVST only for the latter. The local labels support this split, but any alternative label/source interpretation should be resolved before construction.

review_notes: The frozen baseline is Table 5 Panel C’s final joint row, represented as the assigned 40-year Fama–MacBeth fit family. Earlier univariate/component rows and later robustness tests are not added.

Funda fields are mapped only where the paper supplies the item semantics and the local catalog label matches; sample item 12 remains a separate unresolved requirement. Item 1 CHE and item 193 IVST are distinct in both source definition and current field labels.

Exact local probes prove access and selected fields only. No local historical/population coverage confirmation is available; CRSP daily records are a sample membership requirement, not a daily return outcome in this selected regression.
